blocks.en: Abstract
blocks.zh: 摘要

blocks.en: Recent advances in harness-based recursive self-improvement (RSI) have improved video understanding by evolving executable agent workflows without updating foundation model parameters. However, extending this paradigm to omnimodal understanding remains challenging, as the heterogeneous and interdependent nature of multimodal perception and reasoning creates a complex evolution space, making targeted harness optimization difficult. To address these challenges, we propose OmniHarness-RSI, a modality-aware framework for evolving agent harnesses. Specifically, we factorize the evolution space into three capability dimensions: modality routing and collaboration, modality-aware evidence localization, and modality-specific perception. Based on this factorization, we construct a Factorized-Harness Agent integrating specialized perception experts and audio-video retrieval tools. We further introduce modality-guided harness evolution, which identifies deficiencies through structured modality-capability attribution and refines corresponding harness strategies through interactive code revisions and execution feedback. Validation-guided selection and held-out evaluation assess generalization within and across datasets. Experiments on WorldSense, Daily-Omni, and OmniVideoBench demonstrate test accuracy improvements of 8.86, 8.13, and 6.23 percentage points, respectively, consistently outperforming modality-agnostic RSI. The evolved harnesses also demonstrate cross-dataset transfer without adaptation, while reducing planner calls and viewed frames.
blocks.zh: 近期在以取用为主的递归自我改进(RSI)方面取得的进展,在不更新基础模型参数的情况下,通过不断发展可执行代理工作流程,提高了对视频的理解. 然而,将这一范式扩大到对全模式的理解仍然具有挑战性,因为多式联运概念和推理的多样性和相互依存性造成了复杂的演化空间,使有目标的利用难以优化。 为了应对这些挑战,我们提议采用Omni Harness-RSI,作为不断演变的利用物剂的模式认识框架。 具体地说,我们把进化空间纳入三个能力维度:模式路由与协作,模式认知的证据本地化,以及模式特定感知. 基于这种因子化,我们构建了一个“因子化-和谐”代理,将专业认知专家和音频视频检索工具结合起来。 我们进一步引入模式引导的利用演化,通过结构化模式能力归属找出缺陷,并通过交互式代码修订和执行反馈完善相应的利用战略. 验证指导性选择和搁置评价评估数据集内部和之间的总体情况。 在WorldSense、Daily-Omni和OmniVideo Bench的实验显示,测试精度分别提高8.86分、8.13分和6.23分,持续地超过模式不可知的RSI。 已进化的被带还展示了不经过改造的跨数据集传输,同时减少了规划者的调用和可查看的框架.

blocks.en: Harness-based recursive self-improvement (RSI) improves agent performance by optimizing executable perception and reasoning workflows while keeping foundation model parameters frozen [ 9 , 13 , 25 , 27 ] . Recent methods refine context construction, evidence acquisition, and agent workflows through code revisions and execution feedback [ 29 , 16 , 32 ] in video understanding. These studies highlight the potential of harness evolution to improve agent capabilities by refining how frozen models and external tools are orchestrated for evidence acquisition and reasoning.
blocks.zh: 基于哈尼斯的递归自我改进(RSI)通过优化可执行感知和推理工作流程,同时保持基础模型参数冻结[9,13,25,27],提高了代理性能. 近期的方法通过代码修订和执行反馈[29,16,32]在视频理解中完善上下文构建,证据获取,代理工作流程. 这些研究强调利用演化的潜力,通过改进如何为获取证据和推理而安排冷冻模型和外部工具来提高代理能力。

blocks.en: Despite these advances, extending harness-based RSI to omnimodal understanding remains challenging. As illustrated in Fig. 1 , omnimodal questions require different combinations of audio, visual, and textual evidence, calling for task-dependent modality routing and cross-modal collaboration [ 31 , 20 ] . For instance, speech-related questions rely heavily on audio perception, visual event recognition requires detailed video analysis, and cross-modal reasoning may require temporally aligned evidence from both. Harness evolution must therefore account for coupled strategies governing expert routing and collaboration, evidence localization, and modality-specific perception. Their interactions create an entangled evolution space, making failure attribution ambiguous and the effects of unfocused modifications difficult to assess.
blocks.zh: 尽管取得了这些进展,但将基于驾驭的RSI推广到全方位理解仍然具有挑战性。 如图1所示,全模式问题需要不同组合的音频、视觉和文本证据,要求以任务为依托的方式进行路由和跨模式合作[31、20]。 例如,与言论有关的问题严重依赖音频感知,视觉事件识别需要详细的视频分析,跨模式推理可能需要两者在时间上一致的证据。 因此,合理性演变必须考虑到关于专家路线和协作、证据本地化和特定模式认知的结合战略。 它们之间的相互作用造成一个缠绕的演化空间,使失败归属模糊不清,以及不突出重点的修改的影响难以评估.

blocks.en: To address these challenges, we propose OmniHarness-RSI , a modality-aware harness evolution framework for omnimodal understanding. Our key insight is modality-aware evolution space factorization , which organizes editable harness strategies into three complementary capability dimensions: modality routing and collaboration , modality-aware evidence localization , and modality-specific perception . These dimensions govern which modalities and experts to invoke and how to coordinate them, where to locate question-relevant evidence, and how to interpret that evidence, respectively. Based on this factorization, we construct a Factorized-Harness Agent that integrates specialized perception experts and audio-video retrieval tools within a shared executable harness. This structure links the capability dimensions to concrete editable components, enabling targeted and coordinated revisions. Building on this factorization, we introduce modality-guided harness evolution , comprising structured modality-capability attribution and capability-aligned harness refinement . Rather than treating failures as general workflow deficiencies, our evolution agent identifies the affected modalities and specific harness strategies, enabling fine-grained diagnosis of modality-specific perception and cross-modal coordination failures. Guided by these attributions, the agent performs targeted code revisions to address recurring failure patterns, using interactive local trials to assess corrected errors and potential regressions. This process connects modality-aware failure diagnosis with capability-aligned optimization, enabling more focused and effective evolution. Furthermore, we introduce a generalization-aware evolution and evaluation protocol with disjoint evolution, validation, and test sets. Harness candidates are selected based on validation performance, while generalization is assessed at three levels: evolution-set improvement, in-distribution generalization, and cross-dataset transfer without further adaptation. This protocol distinguishes evolution-set improvement, in-distribution generalization, and cross-dataset transfer.
blocks.zh: 为了应付这些挑战,我们提议采用OmniHarness-RSI,即一种具有模式意识的利用演化框架,促进全方位理解。 我们的关键洞察力是模式意识演化的空间因素化,它将可编辑的利用策略组织为三个互补的能力维度:模式路径与协作,模式意识证据本地化,以及模式特定感知. 这些方面分别规定了哪些模式和专家可以援引以及如何协调这些模式和专家,如何找到与问题有关的证据以及如何解释这些证据。 基于这种因子化,我们构建了一个因子化-和谐代理,将专业的感知专家和音频视频检索工具纳入一个共享的可执行工具。 这一结构将能力层面与可编辑的具体构成部分联系起来,从而能够进行有针对性的协调修订。 在这个要素化的基础上,我们引入了以模式指导的利用进化,包括结构化的模式能力归属和能力相配合的利用改进。 我们的发展代理人没有将失败视为一般的工作流程缺陷,而是确定了受影响的模式和具体的利用战略,从而能够对特定模式的认知和跨模式协调的失败进行精细分析。 在这些归属的指导下,代理人进行有针对性的代码修订,以应对反复出现的故障模式,利用交互式局部试验来评估纠正错误和潜在的回归. 这一过程将认识到模式的失败诊断与能力匹配的优化联系起来,从而能够更有重点和更有效地演变。 此外,我们引入了一种具有普遍认识的演化和评价协议,与演化、验证和测试集脱节。 合理性考生是根据验证性能选择的,而概括性评价则分为三个层面:进化-设置改进,分流性归纳,以及跨数据集转移,无需进一步调整. 这个协议区分了演化设置的改进,分配的概括,和跨数据集的传输.

blocks.en: Experiments on WorldSense, Daily-Omni, and OmniVideoBench show that our modality-guided RSI improves held-out test accuracy by 8.86, 8.13, and 6.23 percentage points over the initial Factorized-Harness Agent, respectively, and consistently outperforms modality-agnostic RSI on the same architecture. The WorldSense-evolved harness transfers to Daily-Omni and OmniVideoBench without further evolution, yielding test gains of 7.67 and 12.10 points over the initial agent, respectively, with performance comparable to or better than harnesses evolved directly on the target datasets. Inference analysis further shows consistent reductions in planner calls and viewed frames across all three benchmarks, indicating more efficient use of planning interactions and visual inputs.

blocks.en: 2.1 Omnimodal Understanding
blocks.zh: 2.1 示范理解

blocks.en: Recent advances in omnimodal large language models have enabled unified perception and reasoning across audio, visual, and textual modalities [ 5 , 19 , 6 , 11 , 30 , 31 ] . Beyond unified architectures, recent studies further enhance audio-visual reasoning through reinforcement learning, cross-modal representation alignment, and modality-aware training strategies [ 18 , 28 , 4 , 8 , 15 , 33 ] . Meanwhile, emerging benchmarks systematically evaluate fine-grained audio-visual understanding, temporal alignment, and cross-modal reasoning [ 12 , 34 , 7 , 10 , 21 , 23 , 2 ] . Complementing model-centric approaches, agent-based methods leverage adaptive perception and tool orchestration to acquire and integrate multimodal evidence [ 20 , 3 , 24 ] . Despite these advances, the automated optimization of modality-specific perception and cross-modal collaboration through executable harness evolution remains relatively underexplored. Our work addresses this direction through modality-aware evolution space factorization and targeted harness refinement without updating foundation model parameters.
blocks.zh: 近期在全方位大型语言模型方面取得的进展,使得能够跨越音频、视觉和文字模式[5、19、6、11、30、31]统一感知和推理。 除了统一的架构外,最近的研究还通过强化学习、跨模式的表述协调以及模式意识培训战略[18、28、4、8、15、33],进一步加强视听推理。 同时,新出现的基准系统评价精细的视听理解、时间调整和跨模式推理[12、34、7、10、21、23、2]。 补充以模式为中心的方法、基于代理人的方法,利用适应感和工具协调,以获取和综合多式联运证据[20、3、24]。 尽管取得了这些进展,但通过可执行的牵引力演变,对特定模式的认知和跨模式协作的自动优化仍然相对未得到充分探讨。 我们的工作是通过模式-认识演化的空间因素化和有针对性的利用改进来解决这一方向的,而不更新基础模型参数。

blocks.en: 2.2 Harness Evolution for Video Understanding
blocks.zh: 2.2 视频理解的利用性演变

blocks.en: Recent studies have explored harness-based recursive self-improvement (RSI) as a promising paradigm for enhancing video understanding without modifying foundation model parameters. VideoHarness-RSI [ 29 ] introduces automated evolution of executable context-construction pipelines, while Video-RSI [ 16 ] leverages active video investigation and execution feedback to refine evidence acquisition strategies. VideoEvoHarness [ 32 ] jointly evolves question generation and solving harnesses from unlabeled videos. More recently, VideoHarness-SRSI [ 14 ] investigates overfitting and unreliable feedback in recursive harness optimization, introducing structured search mechanisms to improve generalization. Despite these advances, existing methods primarily investigate harness evolution in video-centric settings, while the heterogeneous expert capabilities and complex cross-modal dependencies in omnimodal understanding introduce additional optimization challenges. Our OmniHarness-RSI addresses these challenges through capability-structured evolution, targeted interactive refinement, and generalization-guided harness selection.
blocks.zh: 最近的研究探索了基于利用的递归自我改进(RSI),作为在不修改基础模型参数的情况下增强视频理解的有希望的范例. VideoHarness-RSI [29] 引入可执行上下文构建管道的自动化演化,而Video-RSI [16] 利用积极的视频调查和执行反馈来完善证据获取策略. 视频 EvoHarness [32] 联合演化出来自无标签视频的问题生成和解析工具. 最近,VideoHarness-SRSI [14] 调查了递归性拉带优化中的过度匹配和不可靠的反馈,引入了结构化的搜索机制,以改善通俗化. 尽管取得了这些进展,但现有方法主要调查以视频为中心的环境中的利用演变情况,而全模式理解中多种多样的专家能力和复杂的跨模式依赖性带来了额外的优化挑战。 我们的OmniHarness-RSI通过能力结构化演变、有针对性的互动改进和通用化指导的利用选择来应对这些挑战。

blocks.en: 3.1 Overview and Problem Formulation
blocks.zh: 3.1 概况和问题的提出

blocks.en: We propose OmniHarness-RSI , a modality-aware recursive self-improvement framework that systematically evolves executable agent harnesses for omnimodal understanding. Our framework improves agent capabilities by optimizing executable perception and reasoning workflows while keeping the parameters of all underlying foundation models frozen. As illustrated in Fig. 2 , OmniHarness-RSI consists of three key components: (i) a Factorized-Harness Agent that organizes editable harness strategies into three complementary capability dimensions, (ii) modality-guided harness evolution that combines structured modality-capability attribution with capability-aligned harness refinement, and (iii) a generalization-aware selection and evaluation protocol that assesses transferable improvements beyond evolution samples.

blocks.en: 3.2 Modality-Aware Evolution Space Factorization
blocks.zh: 3.2 模式-意识进化空间因数化

blocks.en: Omnimodal understanding involves intertwined capabilities for visual, auditory, and cross-modal reasoning. The harness strategies supporting these capabilities interact, creating an entangled evolution space that makes it difficult to attribute failures to specific strategies and target revisions accordingly. To address this challenge, we introduce modality-aware evolution space factorization , which organizes editable harness strategies into three complementary capability dimensions:

blocks.en: For perception, Qwen3-VL-8B-Instruct [ 1 ] serves as the visual expert, while Qwen2.5-Omni-7B [ 30 ] handles audio and joint audio-video understanding. Their harness strategies θ perc m \theta_{\mathrm{perc}}^{m} include task prompts, input organization, interface-supported frame counts and sampling density within selected intervals, and output formats and processing. For example, revisions can direct the visual expert to identify a target attribute or the audio expert to distinguish a target sound from background music. Truncation, concatenation, and simple parsing of returned text further shape the observations available to the planner.
blocks.zh: 对于感知,Qune3-VL-8B-Instruct [1] 担任视觉专家,而Qune2.5-Omni-7B [30] 处理音频和联合音频-视频理解. 他们的驾驭策略 ~ perc m\theta_{\mathrm{perc}}^{m}包括任务提示,输入组织,接口支持的帧计数和采样密度在选定的间隔内,以及输出格式和处理. 例如,修改可以引导视觉专家识别目标属性,也可以引导音频专家区分目标声音与背景音乐. 截断,调和,以及简单的解析返回的文本进一步塑造了规划者可用的观测.

blocks.en: The three dimensions organize strategies within a shared executable harness, allowing coordinated revisions across dimensions. We use GPT-6.1-Sol as the outer evolution agent to refine this harness through the modality-guided evolution process described next.
blocks.zh: 这三个层面在共同的可执行手段内组织各种战略,从而能够对各个层面进行协调一致的修订。 我们用GPT-6.1-Sol作为外演化剂,通过接下来描述的模式引导演化过程来完善这种牵引力.

blocks.en: 3.3 Modality-Guided Harness Evolution
blocks.zh: 3.3 模式 - 指导性利用

blocks.en: While modality-aware factorization organizes the evolution space into capability dimensions, this structure alone does not ensure effective optimization. Omnimodal understanding involves complex tool interactions and tightly coupled capabilities across modalities. Applying conventional evolution methods for video understanding [ 29 , 16 ] to these tasks can lead to two problems: ambiguous failure attribution , where the modality capabilities limiting performance remain unclear, and multiple unfocused harness modifications , which change several capabilities, making individual effects difficult to assess and subsequent refinement harder to target.
blocks.zh: 虽然模式意识的因子化将进化空间组织成能力维度,但仅此结构并不能确保有效的优化. 模拟理解涉及复杂的工具互动和各种模式之间紧密结合的能力。 对这些任务应用常规演化方法来理解视频[29,16]可能导致两个问题:模糊的故障归属,其中限制性能的模式能力仍然不明确,以及多重无重点的调用修改,这改变了几种能力,使得个人效应难以评估,随后的改进更难瞄准.

blocks.en: To address these challenges, we introduce modality-guided harness evolution , which comprises the following two components.
blocks.zh: 为了应对这些挑战,我们引入了由模式指导的利用演变,其中包括以下两个组成部分。

blocks.en: Structured Modality-Capability Attribution. At evolution round t t , we evaluate the current harness ℋ θ t \mathcal{H}_{\theta_{t}} on 𝒟 evo \mathcal{D}_{\mathrm{evo}} to measure task accuracy and record per-example execution trajectories 𝒯 t = { τ i } \mathcal{T}_{t}=\{\tau_{i}\} . Each trajectory contains tool calls, retrieved evidence, expert observations, reasoning, and the final prediction with its correctness label. For incorrect predictions, the GPT-6.1-Sol evolution agent analyzes the corresponding trajectories using the factorized space in Sec. 3.2 , identifying likely deficiencies in routing and collaboration, evidence localization, or perception.
blocks.zh: 结构化模式-能力分配。 在 t t 演化回合,我们评价 Dvo \ mathcal 上的 H \ t \ mathcal{ H}_{\theta_{t}} \ \ \ \ \ \ \ \ \ \ \ \ \ \ \ \ \ \ \ \ \ \ \ \ \ \ \ \ \ \ \ \ \ \ \ \ \ \ \ \ \ \ \ \ t \ \ \ \ \ \ \ \ \ \ \ \ \ \ \ \ \ \ \ \ \ \ \ \ \ \ \ \ \ \ \ \ \ \ \ \ \ \ \ 任务精确度并记录每个实例执行轨迹 T = \ \ \ \ \ \ \ \ \ \ \ \ \ \ \ \ \ \ 每个轨迹都包含工具调用,检索的证据,专家观察,推理,以及带有正确性标签的最终预测. 对于不正确的预测,GPT-6.1-Sol演化剂利用Sec. 3.2中的因子化空间来分析相应的轨迹,找出路由和协作的可能缺陷,证据本地化,或感知.

blocks.en: For routing and collaboration, attribution identifies the execution steps involving inappropriate modality selection, expert invocation order, evidence exchange, or conflict resolution. Within localization and perception, the agent performs modality–capability attribution along two axes: the affected modality (e.g., visual or audio) and the specific editable harness strategy implicated in the failure. Here, capability refers to a fine-grained strategy, such as retrieval query construction, frame sampling within selected intervals, or expert prompting. For example, a diagnosis may associate the visual modality with retrieval query construction or frame sampling, or the audio modality with expert prompting. A trajectory may implicate multiple interacting strategies across these dimensions.
blocks.zh: 就路径和协作而言,归属确定了涉及不适当的方式选择、专家援引命令、证据交换或冲突解决的执行步骤。 在本地化和感知中,代理人按照两个轴线执行模式-能力归属:受影响的模式(例如视觉或音频)和与失败有关的可编辑的具体控制策略。 在这里,能力是指精细的策略,如检索查询构造,选定间隔内帧采样,或专家提示. 例如,诊断可能将视觉模式与检索查询构建或帧取样联系起来,或将音频模式与专家提示联系起来。 轨迹可能涉及跨越这些层面的多种互动战略。

blocks.en: This process augments binary task outcomes with structured attribution results grounded in execution evidence and linked to concrete harness revision targets. These results guide subsequent editing and are assessed through interactive local trials.
blocks.zh: 这一过程扩大了二进制任务成果,其结构化归属结果以执行证据为基础,并与具体的利用修订目标挂钩。 这些结果指导随后的编辑工作,并通过地方互动试验进行评估。

blocks.en: Capability-Aligned Harness Refinement. In practice, we find that attempting to address all identified failure patterns in a single harness revision yields limited improvement. We therefore prioritize focused revisions targeting specific failure patterns. For a selected pattern, the GPT-6.1-Sol evolution agent selects questions from 𝒟 evo \mathcal{D}_{\mathrm{evo}} to form a trial subset, including cases exhibiting the pattern and related cases that the current harness answers correctly. This subset supports targeted assessment of the proposed changes while providing controls for detecting regressions.
blocks.zh: 能力 - 相通的策略 完善. 在实践中,我们发现,试图以单一手段修订处理所有已查明的失败模式,只能带来有限的改进。 因此,我们优先考虑针对具体失败模式的有重点的修订。 对于一个选定的模式,GPT-6.1-Sol演化代理从Devo\mathcal{D}_{\ mathrm{evo}}}中选择问题,形成一个试验子集,包括显示模式的案件和当前驾驭正确回答的相关案件. 这一子集支持对拟议变化进行有针对性的评估,同时提供检测回归的控制。

blocks.en: Guided by the attribution results, the agent modifies the harness strategies associated with the selected pattern and evaluates candidate revisions on this subset. Comparing the current and revised harnesses on the same questions reveals which errors are corrected and whether previously correct predictions deteriorate. The agent also examines execution traces to assess how the revised strategies affect evidence acquisition and interpretation. It uses this feedback to refine the implementation and explore alternative revisions through repeated local trials. A revision may involve multiple components when they jointly contribute to the same failure pattern, and the trial subset can be adjusted as the analysis reveals additional relevant cases.
blocks.zh: 在归属结果的指导下,代理人修改了与选定模式有关的利用战略,并评估了对这一子集的候选修订。 比较当前和订正的利用情况,可以发现哪些错误得到纠正,以前的正确预测是否恶化。 该代理人还审查执行痕迹,以评估订正战略如何影响证据的获取和解释。 它利用这种反馈来完善执行情况,并通过反复的当地试验探索其他修改方案。 修订可能涉及多个组成部分,如果它们共同造成同样的失败模式,而审判子集可随着分析显示更多相关案件而调整。

blocks.en: This process couples targeted strategy modification with execution-based feedback on relevant examples. At the end of each evolution round, GPT-6.1-Sol selects the candidate harness it judges to perform best based on the local trial feedback and submits only this candidate for validation-based selection (Sec. 3.4 ).
blocks.zh: 这一过程使夫妻们有针对性地修改战略,并提供有关实例的基于执行的反馈。 在每一轮演化回合结束时,GPT-6.1-Sol会根据当地审判反馈来选择其法官最佳表现的候选人,并且只提交该候选人进行基于验证的选拔(第3.4条)。

blocks.en: 3.4 Generalization-Aware Evolution and Evaluation
blocks.zh: 3.4 概论-了解演变和评价

blocks.en: Modality-guided harness evolution refines harness strategies through interactive local trials, but improvements on trial subsets may not generalize. We therefore complement capability-aligned harness refinement with a generalization-aware selection and evaluation protocol that separates validation-based harness selection from final generalization evaluation.
blocks.zh: 以模式指导的利用演变通过地方互动审判改进了利用战略,但审判子集的改进可能无法概括。 因此,我们通过一种通用意识选择和评价协议,将基于验证的利用选择与最终的通用评价区分开来,来补充能力匹配的利用。

blocks.en: Validation-Based Harness Selection. For each dataset used in evolution, we construct three disjoint partitions: 𝒟 evo \mathcal{D}_{\mathrm{evo}} , 𝒟 val \mathcal{D}_{\mathrm{val}} , and 𝒟 test \mathcal{D}_{\mathrm{test}} . To mitigate overfitting to the evolution set during iterative harness refinement, we base candidate acceptance on accuracy improvements over the current harness on the held-out validation set.

blocks.en: 4 Experiments
blocks.zh: 4 实验

blocks.en: 4.1 Experimental Setup
blocks.zh: 4.1 实验设置

blocks.en: Datasets and metrics. We evaluate on three multiple-choice audio-video question-answering benchmarks: WorldSense [ 7 ] , Daily-Omni [ 34 ] , and OmniVideoBench [ 10 ] . They cover complementary aspects of omnimodal understanding, including visual, auditory, temporal, and cross-modal reasoning in WorldSense; everyday event understanding and audio-visual alignment in Daily-Omni; and 13 perception and reasoning categories in OmniVideoBench. We randomly partition each dataset into evolution, validation, and test sets in an approximate ratio of 40 : 10 : 50 40{:}10{:}50 . Performance is measured by answer accuracy (%), with gains reported in percentage points.
blocks.zh: 数据集和衡量标准。 我们评价三个多选择的音频视频问答基准: WorldSense [7], Daily-Omni [34],和OmniVideo Bench [10] (英语). 它们涉及全方位理解的互补方面,包括视觉、听觉、时间和世界语中的跨模式推理;每日奥姆尼语中的日常事件理解和视听协调;以及OmniVideo Bench语中的13个认知和推理类别。 我们随机将每个数据集分割成演化,验证,测试集,大致比例为40:10:50 40{}10{}50. 业绩按回答准确度(%)衡量,增益以百分点报告。

blocks.en: Agent configurations. We consider two agent architectures sharing the same Qwen3.8-27B planner. The Single-Expert Agent employs Qwen2.5-Omni-7B as its sole perception expert, operating within an unfactorized harness evolution space where heterogeneous modality capabilities remain entangled. In contrast, our Factorized-Harness Agent integrates multiple modality-specific experts and retrieval tools, and organizes the evolution space into three modality-related capability dimensions, as described in Sec. 3.2 . For both architectures, the initial harness exposes predefined tool interfaces and provides basic tool-use instructions that guide the planner in selecting and invoking tools to answer questions.
blocks.zh: 代理配置 。 我们认为两个代理建筑 共用相同的 Quen3.8 -27B 规划器。 单专家代理 Qun2.5-Omni-7B作为其唯一的感知专家,在一个未构件化的拉带演化空间内运作,其中不同模式的能力仍然缠绕在一起. 与此相对照,我们的因数化-和谐剂将多种模式特定专家和检索工具整合在一起,并将演化空间组织成三个模式相关能力维度,如Sec所述. 3.2 (英语). 对于这两个架构来说,初始的拉带会暴露预先定义的工具界面,并提供基本的工具使用指令,指导规划者选择和引用工具来回答问题.

blocks.en: Evolution and evaluation protocol. We use GPT-6.1-Sol as the evolution agent and allow up to 10 evolution rounds per experiment. Candidate acceptance follows Eq. 4 ; evolution terminates early if the submitted candidate harness is rejected in three consecutive rounds. All model parameters remain frozen, and the planner is limited to 10 interaction steps per question at inference time.
blocks.zh: 演化与评价协议. 我们使用GPT-6.1-醇作为进化剂,每次实验最多允许10个进化回合. 考生录取顺序为Eq. 4;如果提交的考生被连续三轮否决,进化会提前终止. 所有模型参数仍然被冻结,计程器在推断时间每个问题限制在10个交互步骤.

blocks.en: We compare our Modality-Guided RSI (Sec. 3.3 ) with Modality-Agnostic RSI , adapted from prior video harness evolution method [ 29 ] . The latter follows a general-purpose harness evolution paradigm, optimizing executable strategies based on execution trajectories and evaluation feedback. In contrast, our approach explicitly leverages the factorized modality-capability space to identify specific deficiencies and guide subsequent harness refinement through execution feedback.
blocks.zh: 我们比较我们的“模式指导”RSI(第3.3节)和“模式不可知”RSI(第29节), 后者遵循通用利用演化范式,根据执行轨迹和评价反馈,优化可执行战略。 与此相反,我们的做法明确地利用了因地制宜的模式能力空间,以查明具体的缺陷,并通过执行反馈指导随后的利用完善。

blocks.en: 4.2 Main Results
blocks.zh: 4.2 主要成果

blocks.en: Effectiveness of harness evolution. Table 1 compares different agent architectures and harness evolution strategies across three benchmarks. For the Single-Expert Agent, Modality-Agnostic RSI struggles to achieve consistent improvements, reducing test accuracy by 1.56 and 4.14 percentage points on WorldSense and Daily-Omni, respectively, with only a 2.49-point gain on OmniVideoBench. This suggests that directly evolving an entangled harness has limited effectiveness in optimizing heterogeneous omnimodal capabilities.
blocks.zh: 利用演变的有效性。 表1比较了不同的代理结构,利用了三个基准的演化战略。 对于"单专家代理",Modality-Agnostic RSI为取得一致的改进而挣扎,WorldSense和Daily-Omni的测试精度分别降低了1.56和4.14个百分点,OmniVideo Bench上只有2.49个百分点的增益. 这表明,直接演变的缠绕式利用在优化各种全方位模式能力方面的效力有限。

blocks.en: Introducing the Factorized-Harness Agent improves the effectiveness of Modality-Agnostic RSI, yielding positive test gains of 0.35, 1.53, and 2.85 points across the three benchmarks. However, these improvements remain modest, and evolution-set accuracy still decreases by 3.89 and 0.56 points on Daily-Omni and OmniVideoBench. These results indicate that factorizing the evolution space provides a better foundation for harness optimization, but factorization alone is insufficient to fully exploit the structured capability space.
blocks.zh: 采用“因数化-和谐剂”可提高“模式-不可知”“RSI”的有效性,使三个基准的测试结果达到0.35、1.53和2.85分。 然而,这些改进仍然不大,进化设定的精度在Daily-Omni和OmniVideo Bench上仍然下降了3.89和0.56分. 这些结果表明,将进化空间因素化为优化利用提供了更好的基础,但单是因素化不足以充分利用结构化的能力空间。

blocks.en: In contrast, our Modality-Guided RSI achieves substantial and consistent improvements, increasing test accuracy by 8.86, 8.13, and 6.23 points over the initial Factorized-Harness Agent, and outperforming Modality-Agnostic RSI by 8.51, 6.60, and 3.38 points, respectively. Moreover, improvements are observed across all evolution, validation, and test splits. These results demonstrate the effectiveness of combining modality-aware evolution space factorization with modality-guided harness refinement, enabling more focused optimization of modality-specific perception and cross-modal collaboration.
blocks.zh: 与此相对照,我们的 " 模式指导 " RSI取得了实质性和一致的改进,比最初的 " 系数协调剂 " 提高了8.86、8.13和6.23分的测试精度,比 " 模式-不可知 " RSI分别提高了8.51、6.60和3.38分。 此外,在各种演化、验证和测试分裂中都观察到改进。 这些结果表明,将认识到模式的演化空间因素化与改进模式引导的利用相结合是有效的,从而能够更集中地优化特定模式的认知和跨模式合作。

blocks.en: Notably, even before evolution, the Factorized-Harness Agent outperforms the Single-Expert Agent by 7.76, 10.12, and 5.69 points on the three test sets, highlighting the benefits of the factorized architecture and additional specialized perception and retrieval tools.
blocks.zh: 值得注意的是,即使在进化之前,因数化-和谐剂在三套测试中的表现都比单一专家剂高出7.76、10.12和5.69分,突出了因数化架构和额外专门感知和检索工具的好处。

blocks.en: Table 2 : Harness generalization across datasets. Accuracy (%) of the Factorized-Harness Agent with Modality-Guided RSI on each target dataset or transfer from WorldSense.
blocks.zh: 表2: 各数据集的通用性。 在每个目标数据集或从WorldSense的传输中,具有 Modality-Guided RSI 的因数协调代理的精确度(%).

blocks.en: Cross-dataset generalization. As shown in Table 1 , Modality-Guided RSI achieves consistent improvements on both evolution and held-out test sets, demonstrating effective harness optimization and in-distribution generalization. We further investigate cross-dataset transfer in Table 2 by directly applying the WorldSense-evolved harness to Daily-Omni and OmniVideoBench without additional evolution.
blocks.zh: 跨数据集概括. 如表1所示, " 模式指导 " 的RSI在演化和停产测试两个方面都取得了一致的改进,显示了有效的驾驭优化和分布式概括。 我们进一步调查表2中的跨数据集传输,方法是在不出现更多变化的情况下,直接将WorldSense-elected tape应用到Daily-Omni和OmniVideo Bench上.

blocks.en: Compared with the initial Factorized-Harness Agent, the transferred harness improves test accuracy by 7.67 and 12.10 percentage points on Daily-Omni and OmniVideoBench, respectively. Notably, its performance is comparable to that of harnesses evolved directly on the target datasets, achieving 81.75% versus 82.21% on Daily-Omni and even outperforming target-specific evolution on OmniVideoBench (54.27% versus 48.40%). These results demonstrate that Modality-Guided RSI learns transferable harness strategies that generalize across different omnimodal understanding benchmarks, rather than merely optimizing dataset-specific execution patterns.
blocks.zh: 与初始的因数化-和谐剂相比,转移的牵引装置在Daily-Omni和OmniVideo Bench上分别提高了7.67和12.10个百分点的测试精度. 值得注意的是,其性能与直接在目标数据集上演化的牵引装置相似,在日报-Omni上达到81.75%对82.21%,在OmniVideo Bench上甚至表现优于特定目标的演变(54.27%对48.40%)。 这些结果表明, " 模式指导 " 的RSI学习了可转移的利用战略,这些战略概括了不同的全模式理解基准,而不仅仅是优化数据集特定执行模式。

blocks.en: Table 3 : Accuracy (%) on Daily-Omni and OmniVideoBench. OmniAgent (matched) uses the same planner and perception models as our system; other baseline scores are reported in the cited papers. Our WorldSense-evolved harness is frozen on both target datasets.
blocks.zh: 表3:每日Omni和OmniVideo Bench的准确性(%)。 OmniAgent(匹配)使用与我们的系统相同的计划员和感知模型;其他基准分数在引用的论文中报告. 我们的WorldSense-Evolved 牵引装置 冻结在两个目标数据集。

blocks.en: Comparison with existing methods.
blocks.zh: 与现有方法的比较。

blocks.en: Table 3 compares omnimodal models and agents on the full Daily-Omni and OmniVideoBench benchmarks. Our WorldSense-evolved harness achieves 82.12% and 54.00% accuracy without target-specific evolution. OmniAgent [ 20 ] adopts a similar multi-expert architecture but uses stronger closed-source models. For a fair comparison, we reproduce it using the same planner and perception models as ours. OmniHarness-RSI outperforms this reproduction by 10.44 and 12.10 percentage points, respectively, supporting the benefits of our factorized harness design and Modality-Guided RSI under matched model configurations.
blocks.zh: 表3比较了每日-Omni和OmniVideo Bench的全部基准中的全方位模型和剂。 我们的WorldSense-ecultive chape 实现了82.12%和54.00%的精确度,没有特定目标的演变. OmniAgent [20] 采用了类似的多专家架构,但采用了更强大的闭源模型. 为了进行公平的比较,我们用与我们相同的规划者和感知模型来复制它。 OmniHarness-RSI在复制时的表现分别超过10.44和12.10个百分点,支持了我们在匹配的模型配置下实现要素化的带图设计和Modality-Guided RSI的好处.

blocks.en: Compared with Qwen3-Omni-30B, OmniHarness-RSI improves accuracy by 10.04 and 15.60 points on Daily-Omni and OmniVideoBench, respectively. It also surpasses SyncRA with Qwen3-Omni-30B-A3B [ 33 ] by 3.03 and 6.93 points. These gains demonstrate that an evolved harness can effectively coordinate smaller perception experts to outperform a larger unified omnimodal model.
blocks.zh: 与Qwen3-Omni-30B相比,OmniHarness-RSI在Daily-Omni和OmniVideo Bench上的精度分别提高了10.04和15.60分. 它还以Qwen3-Omni-30B-A3B[33]以3.03分和6.93分超越SyncRA. 这些成果表明,经过演进的利用能够有效地协调较小的认识专家,以超越更大的统一模式。

blocks.en: 4.3 Further Analysis
blocks.zh: 4.3 进一步分析

blocks.en: Table 4 : Inference resource usage before and after harness evolution. All values are per-question averages for the Factorized-Harness Agent. Initial and Evolved denote its harnesses before and after Modality-Guided RSI, respectively. Tool calls include perception experts, ASR, and audio/visual localization tools. Bold indicates lower usage within each dataset.
blocks.zh: 表4:利用演变前后的推论资源使用情况。 所有数值都是因数化-和谐剂的每个问题平均值。 初始型和演化型分别表示其在 " 模式指导 " 区域安全倡议前后的利用。 工具调用包括感知专家、ASR和视听本地化工具。 粗体表示每个数据集使用率较低。

blocks.en: Inference Efficiency. To examine whether the performance gains of Modality-Guided RSI require additional inference resources, Table 4 compares planner calls, tool invocations, and viewed frames before and after evolution. Despite achieving higher accuracy across all three benchmarks, the evolved harness reduces planner calls by 17.3%, 40.9%, and 5.6% on WorldSense, Daily-Omni, and OmniVideoBench, respectively, while reducing viewed frames by 3.9%, 14.4%, and 4.7%. On Daily-Omni, tool calls also decrease by 31.1%, achieving simultaneous improvements across all three resource metrics. Although tool calls increase slightly on the other two benchmarks, the consistent reductions in planning interactions and visual inputs indicate that accuracy gains do not depend on uniformly increased resource consumption. Instead, the evolved harness demonstrates more effective allocation of planning and perception resources, enabling more efficient evidence acquisition and utilization.
blocks.zh: 推论效率。 为了审查 " 模式指导 " RSI的业绩收益是否需要额外的推论资源,表4比较了规划员的呼叫、工具引用和演化前后的视图框架。 尽管这三条基准的准确性都有所提高,但进化的牵引装置将计划员的调用分别减少17.3%、40.9%和5.6%(WorldSense、Daily-Omni和OmniVideo Bench),同时将浏览帧减少3.9%、14.4%和4.7%。 在Daily-Omni上,工具呼叫也减少了31.1%,实现了所有三个资源度量表的同步改进. 虽然工具要求根据其他两个基准略有增加,但规划互动和视觉投入的持续减少表明,准确性提高并不取决于资源消耗的统一增加。 相反,不断发展的利用表明规划和感知资源得到更有效的分配,从而能够更有效地获取和利用证据。

blocks.en: Evolution Dynamics. Figure 3 illustrates the performance trajectory of Modality-Guided RSI across ten successive harness checkpoints on WorldSense. The test success rate rises steadily during the early stages of evolution, increasing from 54.20% to 63.06% at checkpoint 7, an 8.86-percentage-point gain. This trend suggests that Structured Modality-Capability Attribution identifies relevant failure types and guides Capability-Aligned Harness Refinement to progressively address them through targeted harness revisions. Subsequent checkpoints fluctuate around 62.36%–62.77%, indicating that further refinement does not necessarily yield additional improvements. The final harness is selected using the validation-based criterion in Sec. 3.4 .

blocks.en: Qualitative Analysis of Evolved Harnesses. Figure 4 illustrates how Modality-Guided RSI improves visual sampling around a localized event and collaboration between visual and audio experts. For the question “Why did the lion’s eyes suddenly turn red?”, the initial harness correctly localizes the event but selects only a frame preceding the change. This leaves the visual expert without evidence of the post-change state, leading it to interpret the lion as sad or crying and produce an incorrect causal explanation. The failure illustrates that accurate temporal localization alone is insufficient when subsequent sampling omits the evidence needed to interpret the event.
blocks.zh: 演化哈内斯的定性分析. 图4说明 " 模式指导 " 的RSI如何改进围绕局部事件的视觉取样以及视觉和音频专家之间的合作。 关于“为什么狮子的眼睛突然变红? ” 的问题, 最初的用具正确定位了事件, 这使得视觉专家没有后变状态的证据,导致其将狮子解释为悲伤或哭泣,并产生不正确的因果关系解释. 失败表明,当随后的取样省略了解释事件所需的证据时,仅仅准确的时间定位是不够的。

blocks.en: After evolution, the harness uses the localized event as a temporal anchor and samples frames both before and after the change. This strategy provides the visual expert with temporal context for interpreting the change in expression and recognizing the lion’s anger. The evolved harness also coordinates complementary visual and auditory observations: the visual expert identifies the lion’s emotional response, while the audio expert detects the sheep crying or calling for help. By integrating these observations, the planner links the visible reaction to its auditory cause and correctly attributes the eye-color change to hearing the mother sheep calling for help. This case illustrates how harness evolution improves the use of localization results for visual sampling and the integration of expert observations for cross-modal causal reasoning, while keeping the perception models frozen.
blocks.zh: 演化后,牵引器使用局部事件作为时间锚点,并在变化前后进行标定. 这一策略为视觉专家提供了解释表情变化和承认狮子愤怒的时间背景. 进化的拉带还协调了互补的视觉和听觉观察:视觉专家识别狮子的情绪反应,而音频专家则检测到羊在哭泣或求救. 通过整合这些观测结果,规划者将可见的反应与其听觉原因联系起来,并将眼色的改变正确归属于听到母羊呼救. 这个案例说明了如何利用演化改进了将本地化结果用于视觉取样和将专家观察纳入跨模式因果推理,同时使感知模型保持冻结。

blocks.en: 5 Conclusion
blocks.zh: 5 结论

blocks.en: We presented OmniHarness-RSI, a modality-aware framework for improving omnimodal understanding through executable harness evolution while keeping foundation model parameters frozen. Our Factorized-Harness Agent organizes the evolution space into three complementary dimensions: Modality Routing and Collaboration, Modality-Aware Evidence Localization, and Modality-Specific Perception. This factorization provides explicit targets for optimizing expert coordination, evidence acquisition, and interpretation. Building on this structure, Modality-Guided RSI combines Structured Modality-Capability Attribution with Capability-Aligned Harness Refinement to connect failure diagnosis with targeted code revisions and execution feedback. A generalization-aware protocol separates evolution, validation-based harness selection, and held-out evaluation. Experiments on WorldSense, Daily-Omni, and OmniVideoBench show test accuracy gains of 8.86, 8.13, and 6.23 percentage points over the initial Factorized-Harness Agent, consistently outperforming Modality-Agnostic RSI. The WorldSense-evolved harness also transfers to both target datasets without further adaptation. These findings support structured harness evolution for improving how frozen experts acquire, interpret, and integrate multimodal evidence. Future work will examine evolution efficiency and robustness across backbones, tasks, and data distributions.
blocks.zh: 我们提出了Omni Harness-RSI,这是一个模式认识框架,通过可执行的拉带演化,在保持基础模型参数冻结的同时,增进对各种模式的理解。 我们的因数化-和谐剂将进化空间组织成三个相辅相成的维度:运动规则和协作、运动-智能证据本地化和运动-特定概念。 这种要素化为优化专家协调、取证和解释提供了明确的目标。 在这个结构的基础上,Modality-Guided RSI将结构化的Modality-Captainable Attibility和Captability-Acental Harness Finement结合起来,将故障诊断与目标代码修改和执行反馈联系起来. 通用意识协议将进化,基于验证的牵引选择,以及搁置的评价分开. 关于WorldSense、Daily-Omni和OmniVideo Bench的实验显示,测试精度提高8.86、8.13和6.23个百分点,一直比最初的“因子化-和谐剂”高。 " 世界智能 " 开发的利用技术也向两个目标数据集转移,无需进一步调整。 这些结论支持有条不紊地利用演变,改进被冻结的专家如何获取、解释和综合多式联运证据。 今后的工作将审查各支柱、任务和数据分布的演变效率和稳健性。
